rules.duplicate_id: Rule “{{rule_id}}” is defined in both “{{previous_file}}” and “{{file}}”; the one from “{{file}}” is used
rules.user_dir_unreadable: Could not read the user rules folder rules.d, user rules were skipped: {{error}}
rules.builtin_invalid: Built-in rules failed to load, only user rules are used: {{error}}
rules.invalid_regex: Invalid regular expression “{{pattern}}” (rule “{{rule_id}}”), the condition is treated as not met: {{error}}
rules.glob_root_truncated: Too many matches for {{path}} (rule “{{rule_id}}”): {{matches}}. Only the newest are used, up to {{limit}}
rules.from_json_too_large: Config {{file}} (rule “{{rule_id}}”) is larger than {{limit}} bytes and was not read
rules.from_json_empty: No paths found at {{select}} in config {{file}} (rule “{{rule_id}}”): the file format may have changed in a newer version of the program
rules.from_json_truncated: Too many paths in config {{file}} (rule “{{rule_id}}”): {{matches}}. Only the first ones are used, up to {{limit}}
rules.from_json_skipped: Path {{path}} from the config was skipped (rule “{{rule_id}}”): $t(issue.rules.from_json_skip_reason.{{reason}})

from_json_skip_reason.duplicate: the path is listed twice in the config
from_json_skip_reason.missing: the path does not exist (the drive may be disconnected)
